question: The mass of an electron is nearly one upon ______ times that of a proton.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The mass of an electron is nearly **1/2000 times** that of a Proton.
 
• **Electron:**
 
 
• **Symbol:** e⁻ 
 
• **Location:** Outside the nucleus.
 
• Electron is a **negatively** charged particle.
 
• **J. J. Thomson** discovered the electron.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

 
• **Proton:**

 
 
• **Symbol: **p⁺
 
• **Location: **Inside the nucleus.
 
• Proton is a **positively** charged particle.
 
• Proton is discovered by **Rutherford.**
 
 
 
• **Neutron:** 
 
 
• **Symbol:** n⁰
 
• **Location:** Inside the nucleus
 
• It is a **neutrally** charged particle.
 
• Neutron is discovered by **Chadwick**.
